decision_scope: APPROVE_ONLY_THE_BOUNDED_POSITION_1_OPI_ARTIFACT_DESIGN_CONTRACT; DO_NOT_MATERIALIZE_OR_AUTHOR_OR_VALIDATE_OPI, CREATE_CANONICAL_OPI_IDS_OR_LABELS, ASSERT_TRANSLATION, UNLOCK_QA, CHANGE_STR003_STR005, GENERALIZE_KE, OR_ACTIVATE_RUNTIME

design_decisions.statement: Use BOUNDED_DUAL_REALIZATION_OPI_SOURCE_ARTIFACT as the position-1 artifact kind.
Represent VALI KE and PARAZAMI KE in parallel and preserve both as the complete closed source package.
Use PARALLEL_SOURCE_REALIZATIONS_NO_TRANSLATION and keep natural-language translation UNRESOLVED_NOT_ASSERTED.
Preserve semantic function CONTROLLED_L03_DIRECT_QUESTION with no subject/person, tense/aspect or copula inference.
Create no canonical OPI ID or label and keep internal selector 1 noncanonical.
If approved, open only a separate position-1 artifact-materialization gate and stop.

governance_decisions.statement: Artifact-design approval is not artifact materialization, OPI authoring or OPI validation.
No realization is promoted over the other by the design contract.
No natural-language translation such as Do you work? or Do you study? is licensed by this gate.
No universal L03/HNK interrogative grammar or question-to-declarative derivation is created.
VALI FROZEN, PARAZAMI WATCH, DARUNO/NELARA parent lexeme gate and HNK3000 remain unchanged.
A future SIGA may approve only this position-1 artifact-design contract while this gate remains active.
